prompt: A delivery driver begins their day with a total of 100 packages to deliver. For the initial batch of 40 packages, they average 5 minutes per package. After completing these first 40 deliveries, they take a mandatory 30-minute lunch break. Following the break, their efficiency improves, and for all subsequent packages, they average only 3 minutes per package. Calculate the total time, in minutes, from the start of the first delivery to the completion of the last delivery, including the lunch break.
